speculation_off_4k.reading: ~8.8 ms of GPU time for every further conversation: ~4.5 is the weights of the 10 experts a new token routes to (10 x 47 layers x 2.33 MB at ~220 GB/s), which conversations with different text do not share; the rest is per-sequence GDN, the multi-sequence sparse-attention path and ~125 more dispatches a sequence (STRIX_NODE_TIMING differences between 1 and 3 streams: routed experts +8.7 ms, GDN +4.4, attention and its membership +4.8, shared expert +2.0, hyper-connections +1.8, graphs off)

uneven_drafts.cause: with STRIX_SPEC_TIMING=1 LLAMA_GRAPH_TIMING=1 STRIX_DECODE_TIMING=1 at 3 streams: target decodes of 5-9 tokens split into 2-3 ubatches (the hybrid memory's split_equal needs the same tokens for every sequence) in 15 of 78 steps, 200-440 ms each against ~150 for an even 9-token verify (timing syncs included), 35% of the decode time; the split ubatches ran without HIP graphs (graph rebuild ~28 ms, submit 40-50 ms of separate launches, 10-15 ms of GPU work)
uneven_drafts.fix: apply_spec_even_drafts: an unconfident sequence keeps drafting while another is confident, all cut to the longest confident run; the server cuts every draft to the shortest when a generating slot drafted nothing, unless one replays accepted tokens

cap_sweep_even_drafts_tok_s.reading: with even drafts the manager's cap (2 drafts for two or three conversations) is never worse than no drafting, so it stays
